decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on mango mousse has public recognition and a visible commitment the firm would not want to write off, so it stays.
The 'Abendbrotkäse' was featured prominently on the home page as a new product, a public commitment that favors persisting with it in its first full year.
The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep, and any early weakness can still be put down to the launch phase.
The spicy cheese got only a low-profile mention and little visible investment, so it is more at risk, but one year is too early to judge it a failure.
The 'Monsieur Jean Bernard' soft cheese was announced as rounding off the new range, which ties it to a publicly communicated initiative.
The washed-rind soft cheese is a niche item with little public commitment, which raises its drop risk, but it is likely kept while early results remain ambiguous.
